title: Messengers of Deception: mass appearance event and blossoming cults
summary: Jason Simosa tells of Messengers of Deception: mass appearance event and blossoming cults, about 1979 at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he talks about how if suddenly there was a mass appearance of UFOs in the world so let's say some sort of event those cults could suddenly blossom whilst trust in the government collapses

plain: A researcher, Jason Simosa, describes an idea from Messengers of Deception, a 1979 book by the UFO researcher Jacques Vallee. As Simosa tells it, Vallee warns that if UFOs suddenly appeared in large numbers around the world, cults built around them could quickly grow while trust in government collapsed. The point is that such an event could be used to reshape what people believe.
